jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Network Capacity management Services
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we run one of the largest networks in the world supporting the AWS Cloud globally. In order to manage this unimaginable scale, we are driving revolutionary changes to the way networks are conceived, designed, built and operated. We put services and algorithms in place to control and manage all layers of the Amazon network, from top of the rack switches (TORs) to our internet and private backbone facing routers. This software ecosystem must be intelligent, scalable and fault tolerant. Our vision is to ultimately have self-managed networks and our Network Lifecycle Management (NLM) organization is responsible for building key services that will enable this vision.  
  
We are establishing a team of engineers that would build a set of foundational network services that form a core part of our Software Defined Networking (SDN) ecosystem. The main focus of the team will be to design and own a closed-loop system for the reservation of network entities associated to procurement activities. This service is vital for closing the gap between network capacity planning and our network automation systems. It is a crucial step towards our vision of a truly self-managed and adaptive network.  
  
We are looking for talented software engineers who want to get hands on experience with fully automated hyperscale data center networks, cloud infrastructure, large-scale software deployments, algorithms, distributed systems and service-oriented architectures (SOA). This is an excellent opportunity for both experienced and new Software Development Engineers wanting to solve some of the hard problems associated with config generation, modeling and storage at a large scale. No prior Networking experience required. In fact, we are looking for members with strong software services background to spearhead development of highly reliable scalable services.  
  
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As member of the team you will:  

* Design and develop highly scalable and reliable services that manage network configuration lifecycle.
* Work with peers, customers and partner engineering teams to develop state of the art solutions, incorporating new technologies, algorithms and innovations.
* Build technical roadmap to evolve our software services space
* Above all build a solid career path with an exponential learning curve, while having fun and making history!

  
About the team  
Diverse Experiences
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers

  
Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  
  
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: .NET Developer
jobs.description:
About The Company

monari GmbH is a dynamic and innovative fashion brand dedicated to creating stylish and contemporary clothing for fashion-conscious women. With a focus on quality, design, and customer satisfaction, monari has established itself as a trusted name in the fashion industry. Our company prides itself on fostering a creative and collaborative work environment where employees are encouraged to grow and contribute to our ongoing success. We operate a network of monari stores and maintain a strong online presence, emphasizing personal customer engagement and personalized shopping experiences. As a growing company, we are committed to sustainability, innovation, and excellence in everything we do.
About The Role

We are seeking a skilled .NET Backend Developer (m/w/d) to join our team at our headquarters in Gronau. In this role, you will be instrumental in designing, developing, and maintaining our backend systems that support various aspects of our business, including our hybrid showroom and dealer applications. Your expertise will ensure that our systems are robust, scalable, and efficient, enabling us to deliver exceptional service to our customers. This position offers a unique opportunity to work in a vibrant environment with a motivated team, contributing to innovative projects that directly impact our company's growth and customer experience. You will be involved in the entire development lifecycle, from conception to deployment, and will have the chance to shape the future of our digital infrastructure.
Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have a solid educational background in computer science or a related field, complemented by practical experience in software development. A completed degree in informatics or a comparable qualification is preferred. You should possess strong proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and SQL, with a proven track record of developing and maintaining web APIs. Knowledge of frameworks such as SignalR and experience with version control systems like Git are highly desirable. Familiarity with agile development methodologies such as SCRUM or Kanban is essential, as is a passion for exploring new technologies and innovative solutions. Excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively within a team are also important qualities for this role.
Responsibilities

As a .NET Backend Developer, your primary responsibilities will include designing, implementing, and maintaining high-performance web APIs based on C#. You will be responsible for the continuous improvement of existing systems, ensuring their stability, security, and scalability. Conducting thorough code reviews and optimizing code quality will be an integral part of your role, helping to uphold our high standards. You will also oversee database management tasks, including updates, optimizations, and ensuring data integrity across various platforms. Collaborating closely with frontend developers, product managers, and other stakeholders, you will translate business requirements into technical solutions. Additionally, you will stay abreast of emerging technologies and industry best practices to recommend innovative enhancements and ensure our systems remain cutting-edge.
Benefits

At monari GmbH, we value our employees and offer a comprehensive benefits package to support their well-being and professional growth. You will enjoy a supportive and respectful work environment within a healthy family-owned company that provides job security. Our flexible work arrangements include hybrid working models, combining time at our headquarters with remote work options, along with flexible working hours to promote work-life balance. We offer competitive compensation packages, including performance-based bonuses, Christmas and holiday pay, and 30 days of annual leave. Employees also benefit from daily warm meals, a fresh salad bar, and a variety of free beverages. Additional perks include options like Jobrad, corporate discounts, access to our employee app, Tuesday breakfasts, after-work events, and various company-sponsored activities designed to foster team spirit and personal development.
Equal Opportunity
monari GmbH is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a diverse team enhances our creativity and innovation, and we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, gender, age, religion, or disability. We are dedicated to providing a fair and respectful working environment where everyone has the opportunity to succeed and grow professionally. Our recruitment and employment practices are designed to promote equality and ensure that all employees are valued and supported in their roles.

jobs.title: senior .net developer
jobs.description:
Senior .NET Developer Ben jij een ervaren .NET Developer die graag meebouwt aan toekomstgerichte softwareoplossingen? Wil je impact maken op uitdagende projecten en technische keuzes helpen vormgeven? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou.

Jouw uitdaging Als Senior .NET Developer werk je aan het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van moderne softwareoplossingen. Je vertaalt functionele en technische behoeften naar kwalitatieve, schaalbare en onderhoudbare toepassingen en draagt actief bij aan de verdere technische evolutie van projecten.
Je denkt mee over architectuur, integraties en ontwikkelstandaarden en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor de kwaliteit van de oplossingen die worden gebouwd. Daarnaast blijf je op de hoogte van nieuwe technologieën en innovatieve ontwikkelingen binnen het Microsoft-ecosysteem en moderne softwareontwikkeling.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden Ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en onderhouden van complexe .NET-applicaties.
Vertalen van businessvereisten naar technische oplossingen.
Meedenken over softwarearchitectuur, integraties en schaalbaarheid.
Verbeteren van prestaties, beveiliging en onderhoudbaarheid van bestaande toepassingen.
Automatiseren en optimaliseren van ontwikkel- en deploymentprocessen.
Uitvoeren van code reviews en bewaken van ontwikkelstandaarden.
Schrijven en onderhouden van unit-, integratie- en end-to-end tests.
Actief bijdragen aan kennisdeling binnen het team.
Evalueren en toepassen van nieuwe technologieën die een meerwaarde bieden voor kwaliteit, efficiëntie en innovatie.

Jouw profiel Je bent een analytische en oplossingsgerichte professional die graag werkt aan technische uitdagingen en kwaliteit hoog in het vaandel draagt.
Daarnaast beschik je over:
Minimaal 5 à 6 jaar ervaring als .NET Developer.
Sterke kennis van C#, .NET en moderne backend-development.
Inzicht in softwarearchitectuur, design patterns en API-design.
Ervaring met cloudomgevingen en moderne ontwikkelmethodologieën.
Kennis van CI/CD, testing en kwaliteitsbewaking.
Een gestructureerde en proactieve werkhouding.
Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en een echte teamspeler-mentaliteit.
Een passie voor technologie en continue verbetering.

Wat bieden wij? Uitdagende projecten met ruimte voor initiatief en impact.
Een innovatieve werkomgeving waarin kennisdeling centraal staat.
Uitgebreide opleidings- en groeimogelijkheden.
Flexibele werkregeling met aandacht voor een gezonde work-life balance.

Waarom kiezen voor ons? Je komt terecht in een omgeving waar innovatie, kwaliteit en samenwerking centraal staan. Je krijgt de kans om mee te bouwen aan duurzame oplossingen, je technische expertise verder uit te diepen en actief bij te dragen aan de toekomst van softwareontwikkeling.

jobs.title: Senior .Net Developer (Angular/Blazor) - Gent
jobs.description:
#dotnetdeveloper #medior #senior #gent #netdeveloper #fullstack #blazor #angular

Ben je op zoek naar een bedrijf die jou alle kansen biedt om verder te groeien als .Net developer dankzij goeie training en ondersteuning? Onze partner groeit en zoekt daarom een .Net developer! Zij bieden softwaretoepassingen en applicaties aan binnen verschillende domeinen, voornamelijk voor openbare besturen zoals steden, gemeenten en andere overheidsinstanties. Voor verschillende business units zijn we momenteel op zoek naar een Senior .Net developer
die graag wilt meewerken aan diverse toepassingen met maatschappelijke impact. Dit is geen consultancybureau, je werkt vanuit Gent centrum met een hybride werkregeling. Klinkt jou dit interessant? - Lees dan zeker verder!

Wat zijn jouw verantwoordelijkheden als .NET developer?

Je ontwikkelt applicaties gebaseerd op .NET (framework, standard én core), MS SQL-server, Blazor en Bootstrap. Een overzicht van je belangrijkste taken en verantwoordelijkheden :
• Je maakt technische analyses van de functionele opdrachten die je krijgt.
• Je bouwt toepassingen en software voor onze klanten en voor intern gebruik. Dit kan gaan om nieuwe ontwikkelingen of om modernisering van bestaande toepassingen.
• Je documenteert de door jou ontwikkelde software.
• Je neemt deel aan het testen van je eigen code en die van je collega's.
• Je biedt 3de-lijnsondersteuning aan klanten en productbeheerders over de door jou ontwikkelde software.
• Je ondersteunt de verkoopploeg bij het opstellen van functionele specificaties.
• Je onderhoudt de software waaraan jij gebouwd hebt.

Wie zoeken we?

Must have:

• Je hebt reeds ervaring als . Net
developer ( min. 7 jaar of meer
) – Senior niveau

• Je hebt een goede kennis van Blazor en/of Angular
.
• Je hebt ervaring met SQL
-server en kent het belang van sterk database-design.
• Je kan je vinden in de methodologieën van Agile
en scrum
.
• Je beschikt over een sterk analytisch denkvermogen.
• Je werkt klantgericht en kan vlot
communiceren
in het Nederlands
én Engels.

Nice to have:

• Ervaring in ontwikkeling van mobiele toepassingen is een pluspunt.
• Je hebt een brede ICT-kennis en interesse en termen zoals OIDC, OAuth, RBAC, REST API, OpenAPI, Swagger, unit testing en Stored Procedures zijn je niet onbekend.
• Interesse en/of ervaring in AI
binnen softwareontwikkeling
is een pluspunt.
• Kennis van andere talen
zijn ook een pluspunt.

Wat mag jij verwachten?

Je mag rekenen op een goeie training en ondersteuning bij opstart. Dankzij deze goeie trainingen heb je de kans om jezelf verder te ontplooien en te groeien op professioneel niveau.

Bij opstart zal je ook een meter of peter krijgen, hij/zij is jouw eerste aanspreekpunt
bij wie je steeds terecht kan. Zo sta je er zeker niet alleen voor!
Naast een goeie training en ondersteuning mag je rekenen op een marktconforme
verloning en daarnaast tal van extralegale voordelen
zoals:
• Maaltijdcheques €8/dag
• €250/eco-cheques
• hospitalisatieverzekering
• groepsverzekering
• fietsleasing
• + fietsvergoeding
• …

Er is een vlakke structuur, maar je hebt een tal van doorgroeimogelijkheden
: zowel horizontaal als verticaal!
Je hebt de mogelijkheid om tot 3 dagen thuis te werken
en komt terecht in een stabiel bedrijf met meer dan 50 jaar ervaring.

Wil je dit nieuw avontuur starten?

Bel mij op via het nummer 04 98 94 67 40
en stuur jouw CV naar yana.dekeyser@experis.be

Indien je nog vragen hebt, aarzel niet om mij te contacteren.

Tot binnenkort?!
